name: gadwinn/file-transfer
description: File transfer behind one interface: SFTP, FTP/FTPS, Amazon S3 and local filesystem drivers.

suggest.ext-ssh2: Required to use the SftpDriver (ssh2.sftp:// stream wrapper)
suggest.ext-ftp: Required to use the FtpDriver (native ftp_* functions, FTP and FTPS)
suggest.aws/aws-sdk-php: Required to use the S3Driver (Amazon S3 and S3-compatible object storage)

scripts-descriptions.test-all: Run the complete test suite including all quality checks
scripts-descriptions.security-audit: Check for security vulnerabilities in dependencies
scripts-descriptions.test-phpcbf: Automatically fix code style issues using PHP Code Beautifier and Fixer
scripts-descriptions.test-cs: Run code style checks using PHP_CodeSniffer
scripts-descriptions.test-unit-coverage: Run unit tests with PHPUnit and generate code coverage report
scripts-descriptions.test-mnd: Detect magic numbers in the codebase
